name: bitcoin-inheritance-planner
description: ClavaStack Bitcoin Inheritance Planner (web + Android + iOS via Capacitor)

scripts.assets: node scripts/build-icons.mjs && npx capacitor-assets generate --assetPath resources --android --ios
scripts.sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
